overview_description.description:
StartupNow provides services to assist in the creation and development of startups.

StartupNow offers acceleration programs, training sessions, financial modeling, growth hacking,  pitch coaching, customer development, and consultancy services to its clients. The training sessions provide startups with lean methodologies. Growth hacking provides businesses with processes and tools to measure their progress. Pitch coaching is training given to startups on how to approach and communicate with investors.

StartupNow was founded in 2014 by Saeed Omar, Maher Jilani, Shiraz Shirari, and Hamza Jilani and is based in Amman.
